policy: A YARA match is supplemental evidence and never a standalone SigmaScope verdict.
Every rule file must have a same-name metadata sidecar and must default to disabled until reviewed.
The sidecar reviewedRuleSha256 must match the exact rule bytes frozen into Definitions.
Enabled rules are compile-checked by the Definitions build before publication.
Rule provenance and licensing must be explicit and reviewable.
Rules with broad or heuristic conditions must document their expected false-positive behavior.
Rule and metadata changes are frozen into Definitions and invalidate artifact-analysis cache identity.
Third-party rules must retain their upstream provenance and license; no upstream pack is enabled wholesale.
